title: Engine trashes a dying {Unstable} card in the bin; the printed reminder erases it instead of binning it
summary: Under the owner ruling of 2026-08-24 (“an {Unstable} unit that dies IS…”) the engine pushes a dying {Unstable} card into the bin, trashes it there (firing "when I am trashed" and the trash watchers, and raising the per-battle count), then sweeps it to the erased pile. The printed reminder replaces the bin entry with an erase, so under the authority order the card is never trashed. The same divergence as F-U07-6, seen from the trash rule; merge them in Stage D. A divergence pending the owner's answer to D-U18-1 / D-U07-3, not necessarily a bug.

closed: by design 2026-10-22 (CT-246 closed): the owner, "Trash isnt a trigger tho. Its a kind of death thing." A dying {Unstable} card is trashed as part of its death and ends erased; rules 405.5 and 801.2h now state it.

The owner ruling of 2026-09-20 (“The cache's mod verbs are gated…”) (2026-09-20) made an expired glimpse refuse every verb, mods included, and the Cache row in the same file already says "once it lapses the card is inert". The two rows contradict each other on screen.
